-- AAC Phase 1F
CREATE TEMP TABLE valid_link AS
SELECT
  rl.review_link_id, rl.article_id, rl.doctor_id, rl.status AS link_status, rl.expires_at,
  a.practice_id, a.doctor_review_deadline, a.current_version, a.status AS article_status,
  v.content
FROM `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.article_review_links` rl
JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.articles` a ON a.article_id = rl.article_id
JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.article_versions` v
  ON v.article_id = a.article_id AND v.version_number = a.current_version
WHERE rl.secure_token_hash = TO_HEX(SHA256(@token))
  AND rl.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
  AND rl.status IN ('READY', 'OPENED', 'RESPONDED')
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rl.created_at DESC) = 1;

UPDATE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.article_review_links`
SET status = 'OPENED', first_opened_at = COALESCE(first_opened_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
WHERE review_link_id IN (SELECT review_link_id FROM valid_link WHERE link_status IN ('READY', 'OPENED'));

INSERT INTO `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.workflow_events`
(event_id, entity_type, entity_id, event_type, event_timestamp, source_system, workflow_execution_id, payload)
SELECT GENERATE_UUID(), 'article', article_id, 'doctor.review_opened', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 'n8n', NULL,
  TO_JSON(STRUCT(review_link_id, current_version AS version_number))
FROM valid_link
WHERE link_status IN ('READY', 'OPENED');

SELECT
  IF(v.review_link_id IS NOT NULL, TRUE, FALSE) AS valid,
  IF(v.review_link_id IS NOT NULL, 'VALID', 'INVALID_OR_EXPIRED') AS validation_status,
  v.review_link_id, v.article_id, v.current_version, v.doctor_review_deadline,
  d.doctor_name, d.credentials, p.practice_name,
  JSON_VALUE(v.content, '$.metadata.h1') AS article_title,
  REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(
    JSON_VALUE(v.content, '$.article_html'),
    '{{DOCTOR_NAME}}', COALESCE(d.doctor_name, '')),
    '{{DOCTOR_CREDENTIALS}}', COALESCE(d.credentials, '')),
    '{{PRACTICE_NAME}}', COALESCE(p.practice_name, '')),
    '{{APPOINTMENT_URL}}', '#') AS article_html,
  COALESCE(ap.status, IF(v.link_status = 'RESPONDED', 'RESPONDED', 'PENDING')) AS review_status
FROM (SELECT 1 AS seed) s
LEFT JOIN valid_link v ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.doctors` d ON d.doctor_id = v.doctor_id
LEFT JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.practices` p ON p.practice_id = v.practice_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT article_id, status
  FROM `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.approvals`
  WHERE approval_type = 'DOCTOR_REVIEW'
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY article_id ORDER BY requested_at DESC) = 1
) ap ON ap.article_id = v.article_id;

## AAC Phase 1F - Review Validation

Accepts a raw review token, compares only its SHA-256 hash, marks the link opened, records an audit event, and returns the current canonical article version.

Connect the existing **Google BigQuery account** credential, then activate the workflow.
